description: Enterprise policy seeds for professional services. Load into EnterprisePolicy table at onboarding.

policies.name: Block unauthorised external writes
policies.description: Any EXTERNAL_API_CALL must pass L3 approval — no silent writes to Slack, Jira, or Salesforce.

policies.name: Notify on critical risk
policies.description: Any action that creates or escalates a risk to CRITICAL severity must trigger an internal notification.

policies.name: Require approval for large invoices
policies.description: Invoices above ₹5 lakh require L3 approval before dispatch.

policies.name: Block record deletion
policies.description: WAANDA may never delete records — only archive.

policies.name: Notify on low-quality lead auto-advance
policies.description: Alert account manager if a lead with score < 30 is being advanced to PROPOSAL stage.
